desc: The instrument the disclosure caucus has asked for twice and never received. Burchett led the first effort under Speaker Kevin McCarthy in 2023; it collapsed when McCarthy lost the speakership. Eric Burlison led the second on 12 March 2024, framing it explicitly as a money investigation - 'the proposed select committee would first be focused on questioning the Department of Defense on expenditures he believes are for secret UAP recovery programs' - and stating that he had the support of Oversight Chairman James Comer, Burchett and Moskowitz. He had not raised it with Speaker Mike Johnson. His stated reason for needing a select committee is the reason this board exists: 'They weren't transparent to us in a SCIF setting. So they could have brought forward evidence. They could have explained what these Special Access Programs actually do. But they are not willing to do that with Congress.' A select committee would carry its own clearance posture and its own subpoena authority, and would therefore route around the HASC/HAC-D read-in gate. It has never been created.
